title: One arrow points the wrong way

text.guided: An arrow with the right length but the opposite direction turns the plane over: the shape is mirrored and its area becomes negative. Check the sign of every coordinate of each arrow tip.
text.fast: Opposite sign on one column mirrors the plane; recheck signs.
